title: Went there and back again, so long Chicago! #chicago #greattheatreven...
transcript: Welcome to the great theater Adventure! Day 8 Another day of seeing as much theater as possible over the next 30 days. Today was the final day in Chicago, so after checking out of the hostel and getting a bit of work done, I decided to take it easy with a nice stroll along the river. For an added bonus, found a free museum along the way. The perks of traveling as light as I do is that I can bring my stuff wherever I need to. But on days like today where I don't have the option to store my bag until after the show ends, I do have to end up carrying it with me, and that can become cumbersome after a while. So I kept the walking to a minimum and headed straight to Chicago Shakes on Navy Pier to see if they had any discount ticket options available for their new Lord of the rings musical. Now the good news is Chicago Shakes does offer discount tickets. The bad news is I have aged out of the program. So shout out to the box office worker that got me a little bit of a discount to get me this really great seat for under 50 bucks! It was great to get to revisit Chicago Shakes. I love this theater and have not been back since the world premiere of the notebook musical. The show was quite a journey and was almost three hours. So by the Time I got out, it was time to walk back through Chicago and head to the airport. Loved getting to make a pit stop in Chicago, but it's time to head back to New York. See you tomorrow.
